versions.description_html:
Learn what Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence is, how indicators of compromise work, and how analysts track threat actors and infrastructure.

The alert on your screen never tells you who is attacking you. It tells you something broke, and then it leaves you guessing.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Threat Intelligence Actually Is
  • Indicators of Compromise: The Breadcrumbs
  • Threat Actors: Who Is Behind the Attack
  • Infrastructure Analysis: Following the Trail
  • Using It in an Investigation
  • Community Versus Premium: What Is Free and What Is Not
  • Where This Leaves You

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Microsoft Purview as a Business Intelligence Layer
  • Microsoft Sentinel - Simply Explained
  • More Microsoft Security episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of Microsoft Security: the most-listened episodes
